block.title: Customer Portal Runtime
block.description: CMS-compatible authenticated customer portal using native ES modules, vertical profiles, route guards, truthful adapters, and explicit command states.

care.note: Customer and tenant scope, permissions, and entitlements are resolved at runtime and are never CMS defaults.

runtime.serving: Must be served over HTTP. Native ES modules do not run from file://.

fallbackCopy.disabledModule: This portal module is not enabled for the current profile

uploadGuardrails: Do not upload without explicit current-thread approval.
Do not encode live customer data as CMS defaults.
Keep PageContext values as authored overrides only.
Do not author customer entitlements, permission decisions, customer scope, tenant scope, or sensitive Care data in CMS parameters.

template:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en" data-theme="{{portal_theme}}" data-mode="{{portal_default_mode}}">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <title>{{portal_title}}</title>
  <link rel="icon" href="data:,">
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="../runtime/styles/tokens.css">
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="../runtime/styles/base.css">
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="../runtime/styles/shell.css">
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="../runtime/styles/components.css">
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="../runtime/styles/routes.css">
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="../runtime/styles/responsive.css">
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="../runtime/styles/seo.css">
</head>
<body>
  <section
    id="app"
    data-portal-api-base="{{portal_api_base}}"
    data-portal-organization="{{portal_organization}}"
    data-portal-vertical="{{portal_vertical}}"
    data-portal-profile="{{portal_profile}}"
    data-portal-theme="{{portal_theme}}"
    data-portal-default-mode="{{portal_default_mode}}"
    data-portal-router-mode="{{portal_router_mode}}"
    data-portal-default-route="{{portal_default_route}}"
    data-portal-enabled-modules="{{portal_enabled_modules}}"
    data-portal-auth-mode="{{portal_auth_mode}}"
    data-portal-error-mode="{{portal_error_mode}}"
    data-portal-data-mode="{{portal_data_mode}}"
    data-portal-case="{{portal_case}}"
    data-portal-pim-api-base="{{portal_api_base}}"
    data-portal-pim-organization="{{portal_organization}}"
    data-portal-pim-fixture-url="{{portal_pim_fixture_url}}"
    data-portal-pim-product-type-code="{{portal_pim_product_type_code}}"
    data-portal-pim-currency="{{portal_pim_currency}}"
  ></section>
  <script type="module" src="../runtime/src/app.js"></script>
</body>
</html>
